5937.d: Mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale, lühikesed vurrud, tumedad juuksed langusega paremale pool. Seljas must kuub, kaelas must eest seotud kaelaside. Valge rinnaesine kahe musta nööbiga ja värvipaelaga (sinine, violetne, valge) Taust pruunikashall.
5937.de: Bust portrait of a man in half-profile to the right, short moustache, dark hair falling to the right. Wearing a black coat, a black cravat tied at the front around the neck. White shirt front with two black buttons and a coloured ribbon (blue, violet, white). Background brownish-grey.

5939.d: Käed rüpes toolil istuv noor naine poolprofiilis vasakule. Soeng kahe käharrulliga ülalpool kõrva, mõlemal pool keskel olevast (?) lahku. Seljas tume maani ulatuv kleit, mille pihiku osa lõpeb ees nurgaga. Kleidil valge poole rinnani ulatuv ja õlgu kattev krae, mille üle kitsam kahekordne kroogitud krae.
5939.de: A young woman sitting on a chair with her hands in her lap, in half-profile to the left. Hairstyle with two curled rolls above the ear, parted on both sides from the middle (?). Wearing a dark dress reaching to the ground, the bodice part of which ends in a point at the front. On the dress a white collar reaching halfway to the chest and covering the shoulders, over which a narrower double gathered collar.

5947.d: Vanema tumedajuukselise mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis vasakule, mustas kõrge kraega kuues, millel kõrge valge kaelus. Kaelas ja rinnal rida ordeneid.
5947.de: Bust portrait of an older dark-haired man in half-profile facing left, in a black garment with a high collar, on which a high white collar. On the neck and chest a row of orders.

5948.d: Suure puu all istuva noore naise põlvepilt, poolprofiilis vasakule. Seljas suure dekolteega roosa kleit. Vasakus süles lebavas käes kimbuke lilli.
5948.de: Knee-length portrait of a young woman sitting under a large tree, in half-profile to the left. Wearing a pink dress with a large décolleté. In her lap, resting in her left hand, a small bunch of flowers.

6194.d: Tütarlapse poolfiguur istuvas asendis, käed süles. Pea en face, pisut kallutatud. Seljas valge kleit rüüžkaelusega ja tume jakk. Õlgadel pikk taskukellakett.
6194.de: Half-figure of a girl in a seated position, hands in her lap. Head en face, slightly tilted. Wearing a white dress with a ruffled collar and a dark jacket. A long pocket-watch chain on her shoulders.

6488.d: Mehe poolfiguur seisvas asendis otsevaates, pea pööratud vasakule. Tuume juuks ja ülikond. Vasak käsi puusal, parem toetub alusele.
6488.de: A man's half-figure standing frontally, head turned to the left. Dark hair and a suit. Left hand on the hip, right resting on a base.

6709.d: Vanema naise rinnapilt en face, valge kraega pruunikas punases kleidis, pitstanu ja krae, kullast kellakett. Kaelas ja vöö külge kinnitatud.
6709.de: Chest portrait of an older woman en face, in a brownish red dress with a white collar, a lace bonnet and collar, a gold watch chain. Attached to the neck and waist.

6793.d: Heledajuukselise sinisilmse lapse poolfiguur, pea poolprofiilis vasemale. Valge üle õlgade lahti vajunud kleit seotud keskelt sinise šärbiga. Rinnale tõstetud parema käe vangus korvike puuviljaga.
6793.de: Half-figure of a fair-haired, blue-eyed child, head in half-profile to the left. White dress slipped off the shoulders, tied at the middle with a blue sash. The bend of the right arm, raised to the chest, holds a small basket with fruit.

6897.dm: diameeter: 140.0 cm (tondo); laius: 148.0 cm; kõrgus: 148.0 cm
6897.d: Keskel pilvist ümbritsetud troonistmel istuv ingel eestvaates, tiivad laiali. Nägu pöördega vasemale. Parem käsi toetub raamatut hoidvana põlvele, vasemas käes lüüra. Vasemal tiivuline poisike kannab käes plaati tekstiga: NVMINE. Paremal asuval putol käes plaat tekstiga: AFFLATVR. Taust kuldmosaiik imitatsioonis. Kujutatud sõõris.
6897.de: In the centre, an angel seated on a throne surrounded by clouds, in frontal view, wings spread. The face turned to the left. The right hand rests on a knee, holding a book, the left hand holds a lyre. On the left a winged little boy carries a tablet with the text: NVMINE. On the putto on the right, a tablet with the text: AFFLATVR. The background is an imitation of gold mosaic. Depicted within a circle.

6903.d: Rinnapilt en face. Pea pisut kallutatud, ümbritsetud punase linikuga ja kroonitud sinise, tipulise krooniga; pilk langetatud. Foon kuldne, millel pruunikas toonis poolsõõris kulgev  ruudustik.
6903.de: Bust portrait en face. Head slightly tilted, surrounded by a red cloth and crowned with a blue, pointed crown; gaze lowered. Golden background, on which a brownish-toned grid runs in a semicircle.

6907.d: Istuv Põhja- Eesti rahvarõivais neiu. Sinine seelik, põiki triipudega allosas, valge pluus ja kaelas suur sõel. Parema väljasirutatud käega raputab kanadele teri; vasakus, põlvele toetatud käes väike kausike. Ees vasakus nurgas viljavihk ja sirp. Neiu taga seinal rippumas mitmeid tööriistu.
6907.de: A seated maiden in North Estonian folk costume. A blue skirt with diagonal stripes at the lower part, a white blouse and a large sõel (breast ornament) at the neck. With her outstretched right hand she scatters grain to the hens; in her left hand, resting on her knee, a small bowl. In the front left corner a sheaf of grain and a sickle. Behind the maiden, several tools hang on the wall.

7042.d: Lokkis juustega põskhabemega mehe portree peaaegu en face (rinnapilt). Seljas tume kuub. Plastron kaelasidemega.
7042.de: Portrait of a man with curly hair and sideburns, almost en face (bust). Wearing a dark coat. Plastron with a necktie.

7151.d: Pruunijuukselise, vurrudega, valges ohvitserimundris noore mehe rinnapilt. Poolprofiil vasakule. Taust õrn-sinine.
7151.de: Bust portrait of a young brown-haired man with a moustache, in a white officer's uniform. Half-profile to the left. Background gentle blue.

7453.d: Ees keskel kummuli keeratud toobril istuv mees. Vasakus, väljasirutatud käes vahutav õlleklaas. Taga järsk, rohtunud nõlvak.
7453.de: A man sitting on an upturned barrel in the centre foreground. In his outstretched left hand, a foaming beer glass. Behind, a steep, grassy slope.

8132.d: Esiplaanil keskel figuuride grupp. Paremal kõrgendikul karjus kitsedega, vasakul põõsastik. Taamal meri ja vaade Tallinnale.
8132.de: A group of figures in the centre foreground. On the right on a rise, a shepherd with goats, on the left shrubbery. Beyond, the sea and a view of Tallinn.

8291.d: Esiplaanil madal liivane rannikuriba lautrile tõmmatud lootsikuga. Lautri kõrval hargil kuivavad purjed. Paremalt ulatub vette kitsas paadisild otsal asuva supelonniga. Vasakul laiub meri horisondini, paremal näha kauguses sinavat rannaviirgu.
8291.de: In the foreground a low sandy coastal strip with a rowboat pulled onto the shore. Next to the boat, sails drying on a rack. From the right a narrow footbridge extends into the water with a bathing cabin at its end. On the left the sea stretches to the horizon, on the right a bluish coastline is visible in the distance.

8380.d: Esiplaanil vasemal grupp murul istuvaid inimesi, paremal põõsastik. Tagapool keskel, vasemal puud (maali ülaservale ulatuvad) ja kivise kaldaga lahesopp. Taamal Tallinna siluett.
8380.de: In the foreground on the left a group of people sitting on the grass, on the right shrubbery. Beyond, in the middle, on the left, trees (reaching to the upper edge of the painting) and a bay with a stony shore. In the distance the silhouette of Tallinn.

8897.d: Mehe rinnapilt peaaegu profiilis paremale. Peas loorberipärg, suu pisut avatud. Paremas käes sulg kirjutamisasendis.
8897.de: Chest portrait of a man almost in profile to the right. A laurel wreath on his head, mouth slightly open. A quill in his right hand in writing position.

9427.d: Toolil istuva tütarlapse rinnapilt poolprofiilis vasakule, valge tanu otsaesise seosega, pruunid juuksed, paremal all punase polstriga toolikorju.(eesti)
9427.de: Bust of a girl sitting on a chair, in three-quarter profile to the left, white cap with a band on the forehead, brown hair, on the right below the red-upholstered chair back visible.(eesti)

9428.d: Paremal kõrged, jämeda tüvega ja tiheda krooniga pärnad, mille vahelt paistavab väike palkidest küün. Vasemal kuivanud puu, tagapool madalad talumajad, kõrval põllulapil kari. Taamal sinises vinas tasandil Vooremäega.
9428.de: On the right tall lime trees with thick trunks and dense crowns, between which a small log barn is visible. On the left a withered tree, behind it low farmhouses, beside them a herd on a field patch. In the distance, in a blue haze, a plain with Vooremäe.

10075.d: Väikese poisi portree veerandpöördes vasakule. Poisil tume potisoeng ja pruunid silmad, seljas must mantel ja tõstetud kraega valge särk. Maali taust pruunides toonides.
10075.de: Portrait of a small boy in a three-quarter turn to the left. The boy has a dark bowl-cut hairstyle and brown eyes, wearing a black coat and a white shirt with a raised collar. Background of the painting in brown tones.

10080.d: Udune mägimaastik üksiku valgel hobusel ratsaniku ja tema kohal kõrguva tumeda kaljuga. Maastikus vasakul kõrgemaid ja paremal kaljunukil kiduramaid kuusepuusid.
10080.de: A hazy mountain landscape with a lone rider on a white horse, and above him a dark cliff rising up. In the landscape on the left taller spruce trees and on the right, on a rocky outcrop, sparser spruce trees.

22341.d: Graafiline leht metsast lookleva ojaga, mis esiplaanil laieneb tiigiks. Pildi keskel on tiigikaldal lahtiriietunult kaks naist suplema minemas. Heledapäine naine, kelle juuksed on pärlitega läbipõimitud, katab rinda looriga, istudes parem jalg vees, teine toetub kaldal asuvale murule ja vaatab hirmunult paremale. Tumedapäine naine kannab keerulist soengut, kummardub kaaslase poole ja vaatab samuti hirmunult paremale. Ta seisab vees ja toetab pahema põlvega kaldal asuvale kivile. Paremalt, metsast tuleb välja sokujalgne sarvedega satüür, pilk suplejail.(eesti)
22341.de: A print depicting a forest with a meandering stream, which widens into a pond in the foreground. In the middle of the picture, on the bank of the pond, two undressed women are about to go bathing. The fair-haired woman, whose hair is interwoven with pearls, covers her breast with a veil, sitting with her right leg in the water, while the other leans on the grass by the bank and looks fearfully to the right. The dark-haired woman wears an elaborate hairstyle, bends towards her companion and also looks fearfully to the right. She stands in the water and rests her left knee on a stone on the bank. From the right, out of the forest, comes a satyr with goat legs and horns, his gaze on the bathers.
